name: hud_weather_fx_are_point_batch_inside_rect
description: HudWeatherFx::ArePointBatchInsideRect accepts a batch of zClipVert points only when every x/y coordinate lies inside the optional inclusive HudUiRect bounds.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudWeatherFx class pass because the recovered source-level helper models the retail thiscall-shaped zClipVert point-batch predicate as HudWeatherFxPointBatch::ArePointBatchInsideRect.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4be210 validates a leaf thiscall-shaped predicate: ECX is the point batch, pointCount and viewportRect are stack arguments, null viewportRect or non-positive pointCount returns 1, and each point's x/y must satisfy inclusive left/right/top/bottom bounds.

The native HudWeatherFx point-batch smoke verifies null rect and non-positive count acceptance, inclusive edge acceptance, and rejection for x below left, x above right, y below top, and y above bottom.
